reviewer_to_referrer.message_free_shipping:
Hi {{ customer.first_name }},

Thank you for being a loyal customer and leaving us a review. Did you know you can earn {{ points_for_referring }} points for referring a friend?


It's really easy. Just forward this email to your friends and ask them to click the referral link below.


Your friend will also earn a reward. They will get free shipping on their first order.


Look forward to seeing you again soon!

It's really easy. Just forward this email to your friends and ask them to click the referral link below.


Your friend will also earn a reward. They get a {{ incentive_discount }} discount off their first order.


Look forward to seeing you again soon!

Look forward to seeing you again soon!
